description: This file contains utility functions for logging, including response processing, span extraction, timing decorators, and interaction with external logging services within the litellm project.

methods.name: _get_service_logger
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a singleton instance of the ServiceLogging class.

methods.name: _get_parent_otel_span_from_logging_obj
methods.description: Extracts the parent OpenTelemetry span from a logging object.

methods.name: convert_litellm_response_object_to_str
methods.description: Converts a LiteLLM response object to its string representation.

methods.name: _assemble_complete_response_from_streaming_chunks
methods.description: Assembles a complete response from streaming chunks, handling finalization when finish_reason is set.

methods.name: _set_duration_in_model_call_details
methods.description: Sets the duration of an API call in the logging object, with error handling.

methods.name: track_llm_api_timing
methods.description: Decorator to measure and log the execution time of synchronous and asynchronous functions, including interaction with external logging services.
